From Gaussian curves to 3D scenes.

Approximate a 1D function. Extend the idea to 2D and 3D.

1D→2D → 3D→COLOUR → SCENE7 sections · 14 worked questions · linked experiments

THE TEACHING PROGRESSION

Fit 1D functions, then 2D and 3D scalar fields. Add colour and opacity before reconstructing an independently rendered primitive scene from images. Compare explicit splats with a trainable neural radiance field, then finish with a pretrained captured garden. The small experiments use synthetic data; full 3DGS trains on calibrated photographs and uses GPU rasterization.
